title: Mixing: Rock And Roll People by John Lennon | 1973
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon
Engineers: Roy Cicala, Dan Barbiero

John Lennon recorded the song ‘Rock And Roll People’ on 4 August 1973 during the Mind Games sessions.

The song was left off the album, and remained unreleased until 1986’s Menlove Ave. The album version was a composite edit of takes six and seven.

Although never released in Lennon’s lifetime, the song was the first to be mixed during the Mind Games sessions. Although other songs remained incomplete, ‘Rock And Roll People’ was finished and mixed on this day, 15 Augus 1973. The mixing session, as with all for the album, took place at New York’s Record Plant studio.

Page last updated: 13 February 2025
